# Record 20260801-023754-267871b

- **Record ID**: 20260801-023754-267871b
- **Claim**: README.md#target-specification -- gain error (<= 0.5 LSB), offset (<= 2 LSB), INL/DNL and SFDR contributions of the sampling switch, and the input-structure row's settling/droop numbers.
- **Netlist provenance**: schematic (`sim/track-switch-sampling/testbench/tb_track_sampling.spice`) — **taken against a dirty working tree** at commit `267871b48f7da252dc87d4aed829f65eafeccbe3`; not citable as a clean-tree result
- **Corner matrix run**:
  - Process: tt, ff, ss, fs, sf, cap_ff, cap_ss, mim_ff, mim_ss, moscap_ff, moscap_ss, res_ff, res_ss
  - Temperature: -40 °C, 27 °C, 125 °C
  - Supply: 2.97 V, 3.30 V, 3.63 V
  - 117 point full-factorial grid (process × temperature × supply), 117 completed
  - Full PVT matrix per CLAUDE.md (−40/27/125 °C, ±10 % supply, process corners).
- **Statistical convention**: N/A (corner-matrix claim, not a distribution claim)
- **Data provenance**: `simulated` — gf180mcu ngspice nfet_03v3/pfet_03v3 device models, full 13-corner x 3-temp x 3-supply grid; sampled-mode transient (turn-off pedestal, hold droop, worst-case step acquisition), real 8.83 pF per-side CDAC array load
- **Note**: Compares three switch configurations (T-gate 10u/20u, T-gate 40u/80u, T-gate 40u/80u + dummy charge-injection compensation) against the gain-error <=0.5 LSB, offset <=2 LSB and input-structure droop spec rows (README#target-specification), not a single final design -- hence characterization, not a corner-matrix pass/fail.
- **Note**: The bootstrapped-switch branches (bs10/bs20) originally in this testbench are disabled (commented out, subckt definition retained) per DR-0007 (spec/decision-records/DR-0007-track-switch-topology.md): bootstrap was already rejected on independent grounds (sim/track-switch-thd's ideal-bootstrap SFDR upper bound, and the 6.6V boosted-node device-reliability argument), and the boot subckt's internal positive-feedback loop was measured to cost >10x the CPU time of the rest of this deck combined, which is why the original full-topology run of this testbench could not complete under this session's host contention.
